howto.goal: Race one of your pawns to the far rank, or capture every enemy pawn.
howto.setup: An 8 by 8 board with two rows of pawns each. White moves first.

sections.title: Moving
sections.text: Pawns step one square straight forward, or one square diagonally forward; a diagonal step can capture an enemy pawn.

sections.title: No going back
sections.text: Pawns never move backwards, so every step commits you.

sections.title: Winning
sections.text: Reaching the far rank with any pawn wins at once. Taking every enemy pawn also wins.

controls: Click a pawn, then the square to move to.
The ringed squares are the moves this lesson wants.
Diagonal squares can capture or step into an empty square; straight squares are quiet steps.

demo.intro: The computer plays both sides, pushing pawns toward each other.

lines.say: Black mirrors. Soon one side must commit diagonally.

demo.outro: The first side to create a gap usually loses the race — keep your line unbroken.

steps.say: Click a pawn and step it straight forward.
Keep your pawns side by side so nothing can slip between them.
Capture diagonally when a pawn can get past the line.
The first pawn to the far rank wins — watch the race.
